manual.title: Start manually
manual.description: Runs when you press Run now.

schedule.title: On a schedule
schedule.description: Runs by itself every few minutes, daily, weekly or monthly.

webhook.title: When a web address is called
webhook.description: Runs when another app sends data to this flow’s secret link.

folder.title: When a file appears in a folder
folder.description: Runs once for each new file saved in a folder on this computer.

request.title: Call a web address
request.description: Sends a request to another app or site and gets its answer.

delay.title: Wait
delay.description: Waits for a while before going on.

wait_for_webhook.title: Wait for another app
wait_for_webhook.description: Pauses until another app calls this step’s link.

approval.title: Ask for approval
approval.description: Pauses until someone approves or rejects.

if.title: If
if.description: Goes one way or the other depending on a value.

set.title: Set fields
set.description: Creates named values to use in the next steps.

read_table.title: Read a spreadsheet
read_table.description: Reads the rows of a CSV or Excel file on this computer.

send.title: Send an email
send.description: Sends an email from your account, with an optional file attached.

send.title: Send on Telegram
send.description: Your bot sends a message or a picture to you, a group or a channel.

generate.title: Ask AI
generate.description: Claude writes, summarizes or answers using values from earlier steps. The prompt is sent to Anthropic.

hints.folder: Full path, e.g. /Users/you/Downloads or ~/Downloads. Files already there are ignored.
hints.pattern: e.g. *.pdf, or several: *.jpg, *.png. Leave * for every file.
hints.path: Full path of a .csv or .xlsx file, e.g. ~/Documents/quotes.csv. The first row names the columns.
hints.pick: Later steps use it as row.<column>. “Next row each week” goes through the list, one row per week.
hints.sheet: For Excel files; empty uses the first sheet.
hints.to: Addresses separated by commas. Empty sends it to you.
hints.attachment: Full path of a file, e.g. a picture made by an earlier step.
hints.image: Full path of a picture, e.g. the image made by an earlier step.
hints.chatId: Empty sends it to your chat (set in Connections). For a channel, use @channel_name.
hints.instructions: Optional: how to answer (tone, length, language).
